about: P3 visual floor (plan 6.2): two clean captures per case from an unmodified main (base c709d09d), 1280x720, separate processes, idle machine. A candidate (P3-Isil, P3-Ifallback) must stay within the floor: with a floor of 0 that means mean_abs=0 over1=0 over8=0 against the capture from main.

stack.shows: three cubes stacked, the ghost hovering above them: footprint ring, light prism column, ground decal

gift.shows: one cube placed, a bomb gift fed and held over the ghost: held-gift presentation

capture_command: python tools/godot_slots.py run -- godot --windowed --position 10000,10000 --resolution 320x180 --audio-driver Dummy --fixed-fps 60 --path <checkout> res://tools/shot.tscn -- --agent-probe --out=<dir> --render-size=1280x720 --target=scene --path=res://tests/bench/bench_p3_visual.tscn --visual-case=<stack|gift> --hud=0 --pin-sky-time=100,50 --rng-seed=20261025 --frames=440 --name=<stack|gift>
gate: Run the capture on main and on the candidate for both cases, then the diff for both; each IMAGE_DIFF line must be mean_abs=0 over1=0 over8=0 (exit 0). Capture main fresh in the same session if the GPU driver or machine changed.
